description: Conversion of garage into habitable room, replacement of glazing and new flat roof to existing rear extension.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice. 2601.ex.052601.ex.062601.ex.072601.ex.082601.ex.022601.ex.032601.ex.042601.ex.092601.ex.102601.ex.112601.ex.122601.ex.01 Revision A (Location site plan)2601.ex.00 Revision A (Bock Plan)2601.pl.022601.pl.032601.pl.042601.pl.052601.pl.062601.pl.072601.pl.082601.pl.092601.pl.102601.pl.112601.pl.12Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.
